nodes.name: Every minute
nodes.notes: Drains the notification outbox. Every minute is the right cadence: a handover alert that arrives 60 seconds late is fine, one that arrives 15 minutes late is not.

nodes.name: Drain the outbox
nodes.notes: Claims a batch with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, so overlapping runs take disjoint batches rather than double-sending. That makes a slow run safe to overlap with the next tick — no lock file, no singleton flag.

meta.description:
Delivers queued notifications across email, SMS, WhatsApp, webhook and Slack. Dashboard notifications need no delivery — the dashboard reads the table.

saveDataSuccessExecution=none: this runs 1,440 times a day and successful runs are noise. Failures are kept.
